items.claim: Karolina Judice will likely win by knockout after the first round.
items.quote: I think after the first round she probably wins by knockout.

items.claim: Mark O. Madsen gives up all kinds of real estate and lets opponents do whatever they want.
items.quote: when I watch Mark O. Madsen, I feel like nothing's happening. I feel like he's given up all kinds of real estate, letting guys get away with whatever they want.

items.claim: Mark O. Madsen does not hit opponents with a whole lot of power.
items.quote: And when he's hitting them, he's not hitting them with a whole lot of power.

items.claim: Kennedy Nzechukwu is a superior athlete compared to Shamil Gaziev.
items.quote: Kennedy Nzechukwu is just a superior athlete.

items.claim: Shamil Gaziev is giving up youth, length, speed, and grappling ability to Kennedy Nzechukwu.
items.quote: He's giving up youth, length, speed, grappling ability to Kennedy Nzechukwu.

items.claim: Shamil Gaziev is likely to come into the fight a little bit gun-shy because he got knocked out in his last two fights.
items.quote: Shamil Gaziev is probably going to come in here a little bit gun-shy because he got slept in his last two fights.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer does everything a little bit better than Elise Reed and will look bigger on fight night.
items.quote: Chanel Dyer just does everything a little bit better than what Elise Reed would do. And she's going to look a lot bigger in there come fight time.

items.claim: Chris Padilla has superior footwork and technique to draw Nasrat Haqparast in and counter-strike.
items.quote: Chris Padilla is going to use his superior footwork and use his superior technique to be able to draw Hac Prax in, counter strike

items.claim: Nasrat Haqparast lacks the power behind his high volume of strikes.
items.quote: if you don't have the thump behind it, then it's just movement.
